scope: 40 noninvalid native expression kinds. Child traversal is separated from type/symbol/context/folded/side-table proof. This is not exhaustive dynamic coverage or a proof for future SDK field additions.

baseFields.type: Recursive closed value/nominal type or explicit wrapper rule.
baseFields.syntaxAndSourceRange: Immutable source/metadata retained by the independent compiler owner.
baseFields.constant: Arena-owned compile-time result does not replace auditing original operands / hidden graphs.
baseFields.attributeMap: Out-of-band for symbol/statement/expression/port connection. Original bound expression retained after value evaluation; scope-filtered fixed point audits internal metadata, excludes current caller/root-connection metadata.

groups.normalChildren: Owned literal storage; no hidden expression children.
groups.additionalProof: Type/builtin lifetime and source namespace retained. TimeLiteral stores its lexical TimeScale; parser context/options witness preserves it. Null/unbounded wrappers have no symbol target.

groups.normalChildren: DataType uses expression.type; TypeReference additionally stores targetType. Empty/LValueReference wrappers have no target pointer.
groups.additionalProof: Recursive type graph or explicit integral TypeReference proof; original type(expr) operand recorded before folding. LValueReference relies on the enclosing audited assignment frame, not a retained runtime value.

groups.normalChildren: MemberAccess visits its base; direct/hierarchical names retain symbol/path metadata.
groups.additionalProof: Direct binding checks, complete local hierarchy path, current frame mapping, base-owned aggregate provenance and fixed/local nominal type graph. ArbitrarySymbol is only admitted through proven control-target/interface contexts.

groups.normalChildren: Visitors cover operand(s), both conditional sides, condition patterns, inside ranges, replication count and conversion operand.
groups.additionalProof: Result/operand types, pattern metadata and actual binding locality are checked separately. Cached constant values remain arena-owned; unevaluated branches are not omitted from dependency closure.

groups.normalChildren: Visitor includes timingControl, left and right.
groups.additionalProof: Lvalue ownership, port/output actuals and Native read/write profiles; no runtime value is memoized.

groups.normalChildren: Visitor covers each operand and withExpr.
groups.additionalProof: Fixed-size stream required. sliceSize is recorded before folding; bitstreamWidth/constantWithWidth derive from audited operands/types/with expressions.
Result nominal type and binding ownership checked. Hierarchy selectors folded out of these value graphs are separately recorded by Lookup.

groups.normalChildren: Visitor covers receiver, arguments, iterator expression or inline constraints.
groups.additionalProof: Scope/subroutine/extraInfo/iterator variable/restrictions are not accepted by child traversal alone. Argument-only contract requires local scope, no receiver and monostate extraInfo; other calls require explicit context proof, otherwise refuse.

groups.normalChildren: Visitors cover size/initializer, optional constructor call, covergroup arguments and copy source.
groups.additionalProof: Close class/covergroup nominal graph, signatures/defaults/prototypes/bases and all constructor actuals. super.new void wrapper still visits its real call. Runtime objects are not compile-time memoized values.

groups.normalChildren: Simple/replicated visit materialized elements and replicated count. Structured visits all setter expressions/indices/default.
groups.additionalProof: Structured type/member identities additionally audited; materialized conversions use already audited setters and closed destination types. Original type-key expressions use the type/control fixed point.

groups.normalChildren: Visitor covers timing event or expanded assertion body/local-variable initializers.
groups.additionalProof: Assertion declaration identity, local variables, recursion and arguments checked explicitly; unsupported formals/recursive contexts refuse. Detailed AssertionExpr/TimingControl field review remains a separate family.

groups.normalChildren: Native visitor visits min, typ and max; selected points to one of those children.
groups.additionalProof: Compilation minTypMax option is preserved; all three branches close even when two are unevaluated. Local/fixed/mutable branch placement checked across min/typ/max options.

groups.normalChildren: Visitor covers left, every value, every explicit weight and default weight expression.
groups.additionalProof: Constraint call context and variable/type ownership still apply. Default weights are qualified with explicit 1800-2023 language options.
Native binder selects member from assignmentTarget canonical union scope. Closed result nominal type/fields close member identity; unclosed/unsupported union types refuse.

newDefect.kind: attribute dependencies omitted from normal AST traversal
newDefect.before: 29 failures in four attachment categories, including stale7 instead of8 and Native flow mismatches
newDefect.implementation: AttributeSymbol retains boundExpression and exposes actual binding scope; certificate fixed point collects local metadata before auditing original expressions. Scalar precomputed bare attributes have no binding graph.
newDefect.callerBoundary: Root instance/connection attributes remain current caller metadata; changing/removing them must preserve body hits and Native flow.

originalReviewStatus: source-field review complete for current expression declarations and common attribute metadata; final all-family/runtime/lifetime qualification incomplete
status: Source-field reconciliation retained; all recorded source definitions unchanged at final candidate. Family-level current qualification complete; not exhaustive per-kind dynamic coverage.
historicalRemainingAtReview: Symbol/type/scope source review recorded separately in symbol-field-review.json
Statement/timing/pattern source review is recorded separately in statement-field-review.json
Assertion/constraint/coverage selector source review is recorded separately in verification-field-review.json
